notes: Thin APT wrapper: it does not carry or install the managed tool at package-verification time.
The companion delivery carries exact DEB inputs and the compatible/incompatible-library experiment; the outer delta corresponding-sources directory carries the exact source archives and patches.
No global APT install was performed for this delivery. APT retains dependency resolution and package-database ownership.

Supply the verified local DEB explicitly with --source apt.abi-compliance-checker=/absolute/reference-prefix/abi-tools/inputs/deb/abi-compliance-checker_2.3-2_all.deb. The original manager refuses a missing explicit local input before any APT installation hook.
APT installation uses --no-download; required dependencies must already be installed or available through the prepared APT cache.
The SPDX expression summarizes upstream LGPL-2.1-or-later and Debian packaging GPL-3.0-or-later; preserve the complete package notices.
